_help: Optional editorial corrections by ticker (normally empty: leaders are checked automatically against SEC filings). Fields: ceo {name, since, bio, photo, photoCredit, photoSource}, chair, website, employees, name, country, city.
_photo_help: CEO portrait from the company's press / media page (link in docs/CHECK.md when no free photo exists). Check it is the right person and that editorial use is allowed. 'photo' = direct link to the image file (.jpg/.png); 'photoCredit' = shown under the photo (default: '<Company>, press kit'); 'photoSource' = the press page, for your records. The engine copies the photo into docs/ceo at the next run. Example: "HSBC": {"ceo": {"photo": "https://www.hsbc.com/.../georges-elhedery.jpg", "photoCredit": "HSBC, media centre", "photoSource": "https://www.hsbc.com/news-and-views/media-resources"}}
